dict.string: HoloSmith connects to the SpatialPuck ESP32 over your local Wi-Fi network to stream live sensor telemetry.
HoloSmith uses the front camera to recognize hand gestures (point, pinch, fist) for controlling the 3D model.
HoloSmith listens for spoken commands (like "reset" or "what color is this") since both hands are busy with the puck and gestures.
HoloSmith uses on-device speech recognition to understand spoken commands for hands-free control.
